audit.previousWorkingTreeStatus: clean before audit artifacts were created (verified with git status --short)

method.coverage: Static audit of source-built Positron extensions, Positron/core NLS call sites, extension manifests, shipped Spanish overlays, and targeted hardcoded UI scans. Runtime findings are separated when opening the flow is still required.
exclusions: English source defaults with an effective bundled-pack or RHS overlay translation
comments, logs, tests/fixtures, generated duplicates, user-authored notebook/output content, proper names, and code identifiers
intentionally excluded/non-shipping extensions from build/lib/extensions.ts and the RHS customization ledger
the hidden Learn section, except as a coverage boundary because it is intentionally inactive

extensionOrder: package.nls.es.json or pinned vscode.<extension>.i18n.json for manifest strings
translationPipeline.validatorScope: The focused validator covers the curated core/session/welcome and environment-health scope; this audit also verifies every statically resolvable shipped extension runtime call, manifest reference, audited core call, hardcoded candidate, and placeholder.

limitations: No fresh packaged-app GUI session was run by this audit; rendered locale behavior still requires packaged-app smoke testing.
The pinned language pack was inspected from its VSIX contents; upstream translations are treated as effective only when the exact module/key or extension package key was found.

This is not an exhaustive audit of every upstream extension contribution or every HTML/string assembled at runtime. The report focuses on RHS-IA-owned/source-built surfaces and shipped customizations.
